name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Reverse-Grip Bench Press
steps: Lie on a bench with both feet planted and hold a dumbbell over your chest with your palm facing toward your head.
Brace your core firmly and place your free hand on your hip or out to the side for balance.
Lower the dumbbell slowly toward your lower chest while keeping your elbow tucked close to your ribs.
Press the weight back up to full arm extension, and switch arms after finishing one side.
tips: Keep your shoulder blades anchored to the bench so your torso does not roll sideways.
Maintain a straight wrist and avoid letting the dumbbell drift too high toward your neck.
